messages:
Maya R: NimbusBank POC: demo tomorrow, they report ~1.2s TTFT on hosted for rwd-3b-v1. Need <300ms for live demo. Also asking if warmup will be expensive. Can we quick-triage?

Ethan (sales): Looping @Sam Infra and @Priya SE. Demo 10:30 ET.

Sam Infra: Quick check: are requests streaming? sample payload? any x-cache headers?

Maya R: Sample (sanitized): {"model":"rwd-3b-v1","input":"Summarize ~420 chars","max_tokens":150,"stream":true}. Headers: x-cache: MISS, x-instance-latency: 1.18s

Priya SE: Likely kernel JIT (~300-400ms) + instance cold spin (~700ms) + KV cache miss. Fast fixes: run a tiny warmup 60-90s before demo (6 requests x ~4 tokens), set prefer_latency=true or batch_window_ms=0 for demo, or use a reserved endpoint (Dedicated) for consistent low TTFT.

Priya SE: Warmup snippet: for i in 1..6; do curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-3b-v1","input":"warmup","max_tokens":4}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate; sleep 5; done. Estimated cost: <50 tokens (~pennies).

Ethan (sales): Nimbus price sensitive. Can you confirm token cost in writing and call out Dedicated option for production?

Priya SE: Will draft pricing blurb. Also we can schedule a Console warmup job if they want automation.

Maya R: They also asked about SOC2/encryption/IP allowlist for webhooks. Can we provide security answers?

Priya SE: Yes, I have the security pack. Ethan please upload their questionnaire and I will fill.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Canary deploy rwd-3b-v1->v1.1 completed in hosted-us-east-1 at 2026-03-20T13:50:00Z.

Sam Infra: Action list: Priya -> pricing + security answers (ETA 2h); Maya -> run warmup and confirm x-cache:HIT before demo; Ethan -> attach questionnaire and loop legal for IP allowlist.

Maya R: Warmup run, headers now x-cache: HIT, measured TTFT ~240ms. Customer happy for demo.

Ethan (sales): Proceeding to procurement. Priya, please attach artifacts to CRM.

Priya SE: Done. Tagged legal for IP allowlist.

Maya R: Thanks — great team work :thumbsup:
